g01_search_policy.look_attempt_mix: scene-wide counted LookFlip >= counted LookStay, across Controller restarts; uncounted native failures earn nothing
g01_search_policy.look_flip: supplement15 original complete native domain, predicted-centre3D roles, entire AABB outside10px and each world one-step positive bbox area; actual rendered/physical acceptance unchanged
g01_search_policy.pool_order: alternate Look/Direct when an available requested mode exists; explicitly record exhaustion fallback
g01_search_policy.quota_skip: retain original validity verdict and record collection_quota_full; never recast this as physical failure
g01_search_policy.stay: original horizontal native domain; original Look12/Direct40 cap and far-first actual-w0 retries
g01_search_policy.unchanged: seed0 role orientation, native token proof, all physical/target/prefix/evidence/solvability/witness thresholds

frozen_pose_readback.scope: actual metadata versus requested pose values; diagnostic, not a new acceptance threshold

restoration.scope: state restore: all movable/pickupable positions <=1cm and exact full agent pose; RGB separate

spawn_token_storage_policy.coordinates: one detached read-only JSON-equivalent coordinate tree per actual query; deepcopy shares only that tree
spawn_token_storage_policy.deadline: original simulator soft deadline checked before query, during coordinate copy and before each point validation/registration
spawn_token_storage_policy.native_query: same GetSpawnCoordinatesAboveReceptacle(objectId, anywhere=True), complete original actionReturn in original order
spawn_token_storage_policy.registration: every original token is registered before return with exactly SHA256(engine.encoded(token)); hash common canonical prefix once then copy hash state per selected point
spawn_token_storage_policy.scope: representation and CPU work only; no native domain, ordering, seed, physics, pixel, target or witness threshold changes
spawn_token_storage_policy.use_validation: unchanged validate_spawn and fresh complete-token SHA256 registry membership at actual placement; no cached caller-token digest
